speaker: narrator
text: Mabli heard a little buzz in the meadow. Some bees needed her help.

speaker: bee
text: Buzz! Can you make us golden again? Tap each bee.

speaker: bee
text: Buzz, buzz! My friends need gold too!

speaker: bee
text: Thank you, Mabli! Now our meadow is buzzing with colour!

speaker: narrator
text: Evening came, and Mabli found a glade full of little fireflies.

speaker: firefly
text: Our little lights have gone out. Tap each firefly to help us glow.

speaker: firefly
text: A little light! Help the other fireflies too.

speaker: firefly
text: Thank you, Mabli! Follow our lights to the rainbow hill.

speaker: narrator
text: After the rain, three little snails peeked out of the leaves.

speaker: snail
text: Hello, Mabli. Will you colour our little shells? Tap each snail.

speaker: snail
text: Lovely! There are more little shells to colour.

speaker: snail
text: Look at our pretty shells! Thank you, Mabli. Let's go slowly, together.

speaker: narrator
text: Mabli found four little ducklings beside the stream.

speaker: duckling
text: Quack! Our yellow feathers are gone. Tap each duckling to help!

speaker: duckling
text: Quack, quack! Help my friends too!

speaker: duckling
text: We're fluffy and yellow again! Thank you, Mabli!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm the paper path. Little feet can tiptoe along me.

speaker: narrator
text: Pat, pat! Shall we explore this lovely page together?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a tree. My branches reach up high!

speaker: narrator
text: Rustle, rustle! Can you tickle my leaves?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a tree, not a frog. Frogs go ribbit!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a tree, not a fox. Foxes have fluffy tails!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a tree, not a rabbit. Rabbits have long ears!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a bush. Lots of little leaves make me cosy!

speaker: narrator
text: Rustle, rustle! I wonder who is hiding here.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a bush, not a frog. Can you find the little frog?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a bush, not a fox. Look for our fluffy friend!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a bush, not a rabbit. Can you spot two long ears?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a smooth little rock. Tap, tap, tap!

speaker: narrator
text: I like sitting very still in the sunshine.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a rock, not a frog. Our frog can hop!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a rock, not a fox. Look for a fluffy tail.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a rock, not a rabbit. Look for two long ears!

speaker: narrator
text: We are blades of grass. Sway with us!

speaker: narrator
text: Swish, swish! A little breeze tickles our tips.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a little mushroom with a spotty hat.

speaker: narrator
text: Peek under my cap. There might be a tiny surprise!

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a flower. My petals open like little hands.

speaker: narrator
text: Hello, little bee! Have you come to visit?

speaker: narrator
text: Knock, knock! This is a little paper house.

speaker: narrator
text: A cosy home, with a roof and a little door.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a hill. I roll up high and down low!

speaker: narrator
text: Imagine sliding down my soft, grassy side.

speaker: narrator
text: Look up! The sky is a big blanket over our world.

speaker: narrator
text: Hello, sky! Is there a little cloud sailing by?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm the sun. I send warm, gentle sunshine.

speaker: narrator
text: Shine, shine! A happy day is peeking through.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a soft little cloud, floating by.

speaker: narrator
text: Puff, puff! What shape can you see in me?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a pond. Little ripples go round and round.

speaker: narrator
text: Splash! Shall we see who is hiding in the water?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a little stream. Listen: trickle, trickle!

speaker: narrator
text: Follow my ripples. Someone small might swim past.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a lily pad. I float like a little boat.

speaker: narrator
text: A cosy little seat for a tired frog.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a tall reed beside the water.

speaker: narrator
text: Sway, sway! I wave hello to the pond.

speaker: narrator
text: I'm an apple, round and ready for a little tap.

speaker: narrator
text: I grow on a tree. Can you spot my tiny stalk?

speaker: narrator
text: I'm a rainbow. So many lovely colours in one big bow!

speaker: narrator
text: Follow my colours up and over the sky.

speaker: mabli
text: Hello! I'm Mabli. Will you explore with me?

speaker: mabli
text: My rainbow hair wiggles when I'm happy!

speaker: frog
text: Ribbit! I like to hop by my little pond.

speaker: frog
text: Can you make a tiny ribbit? Ribbit!

speaker: frog
text: Hello again! I am so happy you came to play.

speaker: frog
text: Ribbit! I'm waiting by the pond. Can you find me?

speaker: frog
text: Look for my big round eyes. Give me a little tap!

speaker: fox
text: Hello, friend! My fluffy tail swishes like this.

speaker: fox
text: I have two pointy ears. Can you see them?

speaker: fox
text: Shall we tiptoe through the leaves together?

speaker: fox
text: I'm hiding near the trees. Look for my fluffy tail!

speaker: fox
text: My pointy ears are listening. Can you tap me?

speaker: rabbit
text: Hop, hop! I have two lovely long ears.

speaker: rabbit
text: My little nose goes wiggle, wiggle.

speaker: rabbit
text: Hello again! Shall we do a gentle bunny hop?

speaker: rabbit
text: I'm sitting in the grass. Look for my two long ears!

speaker: rabbit
text: Hop over with your finger and give me a little tap!

speaker: bird
text: Tweet, tweet! I have a little song for you.

speaker: bird
text: My wings can flutter, and my little feet can hop.

speaker: butterfly
text: Flutter, flutter! My wings are soft and light.

speaker: butterfly
text: Can you wave hello like a butterfly?

speaker: bee
text: Buzz, buzz! I'm looking for a flower.

speaker: bee
text: I have little wings and a fuzzy tummy.

speaker: duckling
text: Quack, quack! I like a gentle paddle.

speaker: duckling
text: Can you make a tiny quack with me?

speaker: snail
text: Hello, little friend. I'm taking my time.

speaker: snail
text: My shell has a spiral. Round and round it goes.

speaker: firefly
text: Hello! I carry a tiny lantern on my tummy.

speaker: firefly
text: Twinkle, twinkle! Little lights make the glade cosy.

speaker: frog
text: Ribbit! My green tummy is back! I can splash and hop again. Thank you, Mabli, my colourful friend!

speaker: fox
text: Oh, lovely orange fur! That tickles my whiskers. You found me! Thank you, Mabli. You are a wonderful friend.

speaker: rabbit
text: My brown coat is back! Hooray! I am ready for a little hoppity adventure. Thank you, Mabli. Hop, hop!

speaker: narrator
text: Once, all the colour drained out of the world — every last drop.

speaker: narrator
text: Only one thing kept its colour: the rainbow hair of a little girl named Mabli.

speaker: narrator
text: Mabli found some flowers, but they have no colour. Tap each flower to colour it in!

speaker: mabli
text: So pretty! Let's colour the other flowers too!

speaker: mabli
text: We did it! Look at all those lovely colours. Come on, let's see who's waiting for us!

speaker: narrator
text: Mabli followed the path to a quiet, grey pond…

speaker: frog
text: “Ribbit! I lost my green. Can you tap me and make me green again?”

speaker: narrator
text: The path opened into a dull, grey meadow…

speaker: butterfly
text: Hello, little friend! Our wings have lost their colours. Will you tap each butterfly and help us shine?

speaker: butterfly
text: Ooh, lovely! My friends would like colourful wings too!

speaker: butterfly
text: Thank you! Our wings are bright again. Let's dance across the meadow!

speaker: narrator
text: Beyond the meadow stood a great, grey apple tree…

speaker: narrator
text: The apples have no colour! Tap each apple to fill it with colour.

speaker: narrator
text: Yum! Colour the rest too!

speaker: narrator
text: You did it! The orchard is ripe with colour!

speaker: narrator
text: In a hush of grey trees, someone was waiting…

speaker: fox
text: “Hello! My orange coat is gone. Tap me to bring it back!”

speaker: narrator
text: At last Mabli climbed a hill beneath a wide, grey sky…

speaker: narrator
text: The End. And so Mabli, the girl with the rainbow hair, brought colour back to the whole world.

speaker: narrator
text: The whole sky is grey! Tap the sun and each cloud to colour them.

speaker: narrator
text: Beautiful! Keep colouring the sky!

speaker: narrator
text: Colour rushed back into every corner of the world!

speaker: narrator
text: A little song drifted across the still, grey meadow…

speaker: bird
text: “Tweet! Our feathers need some blue. Can you tap each little bird?”

speaker: bird
text: “Tweet-tweet! Help my friends too!”

speaker: bird
text: “We can sing in colour again! Thank you, Mabli!”

speaker: narrator
text: Something soft rustled in the tall, grey grass…

speaker: rabbit
text: “Hello, Mabli. Can you make my soft fur brown again? Tap me!”

speaker: narrator
text: Deeper in, a little ring of toadstools stood waiting…

speaker: narrator
text: The toadstools have lost their cheerful red caps. Tap each one to colour it in!

speaker: narrator
text: Lovely and red! Colour the others too.

speaker: narrator
text: A whole ring of red toadstools — wonderful!

speaker: narrator
text: Can you tap one? Let's give it some colour!

speaker: narrator
text: Tap the one with the twinkly light. You can do it!

speaker: narrator
text: One.

speaker: narrator
text: Two.

speaker: narrator
text: Three.

speaker: narrator
text: Four.

speaker: narrator
text: Five.

speaker: narrator
text: Six.

speaker: narrator
text: Seven.

speaker: narrator
text: Eight.

speaker: narrator
text: Nine.

speaker: narrator
text: Ten.
